blocking_issues.finding: Conversion silently drops MembershipGold.abstention_allowed. The representation cannot distinguish an ambiguous assignment that permits abstention from one that forbids it.

AssignmentRecord has no field that preserves this distinction. The repaired field comparisons omit it. Reproduction: /tmp/topic02-review02-puf10g5i/probes.py and probes.json, abstention_permission_collision.
blocking_issues.impact: Two semantically different valid assignment contracts collapse into one representation. The 18/18 encoder-to-decoder round trips therefore do not establish the stated lossless representation of authored gold, including its abstention semantics.
